quarterly_data.quarter: Shihlin Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 product mix: Electricity Distribution Products 72.19% of revenue, Automobile Components 14.64%, Automation Equipment and Components 10.43%, Others 2.74%. Heavy electric products include power and distribution transformers, reactors, switchboards, capacitors, gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), bus bars, high-voltage switches and surge arresters; the company cites its 345 kV, 1260 MVA nuclear-grade transformer as the nation's largest-capacity power system equipment.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shihlin Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company: 'Our operations benefit from the global energy transition, grid upgrade trends, and data center expansion plans, making transmission and distribution transformers a key resource and driving strong order momentum.' Export orders from North America, Japan and Southeast Asia grew significantly; demand in the US market 'is expected to continue its rapid growth over the next 5 to 10 years, driven by US tech giants' investments in AI training and data center planning.' Orders from the North American market now account for 15% to 20% of heavy electrical product revenue, and over the next 3 to 5 years 'orders will grow significantly.'
quarterly_data.figure: North American orders 15% to 20% of heavy electrical product revenue

quarterly_data.quarter: Shihlin Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 expected sales volume: Electric Distribution Products 11.97 million sets (2025 actual 11.40 million), total 31.18 million sets (2025: 29.69 million). Company: AI-driven power demand in the United States and overseas investment by domestic enterprises favor exports of power distribution products to the U.S.; Taipower's grid resilience program and rail / infrastructure projects support the domestic outlook. Long-term plan: expand overseas revenue by growing 10% per year.
